k: The Spire's keeper of hours. It has only ever counted to twelve, and it has done so for forty years.
src: 'The Spire\'s keeper of hours. It has only ever counted to twelve, and it has done so for forty years.'

k: "Lovely day for it!" it says, and smiles, and smiles, and comes for your throat.
src: '"Lovely day for it!" it says, and smiles, and smiles, and comes for your throat.'

k: A festival lantern that drifted loose. The candle inside has burned for forty years and never got any shorter.
src: 'A festival lantern that drifted loose. The candle inside has burned for forty years and never got any shorter.'

k: Somebody's dog, remembered as a very good dog. Remembered a little too hard.
src: 'Somebody\'s dog, remembered as a very good dog. Remembered a little too hard.'

k: "Welcome to the Festival of the Long Light. Enjoy the day." Forever.
src: '"Welcome to the Festival of the Long Light. Enjoy the day." Forever.'

k: She has been dancing round the maypole since before your parents were born. She would love you to join in.
src: 'She has been dancing round the maypole since before your parents were born. She would love you to join in.'

k: Mercy's congregation. They sing for her because she promised them they would never have to stop.
src: 'Mercy\'s congregation. They sing for her because she promised them they would never have to stop.'

k: Evernoon's warden. She believes that a day which never ends cannot hurt anyone. She has never once been told no and believed it.
src: 'Evernoon\'s warden. She believes that a day which never ends cannot hurt anyone. She has never once been told no and believed it.'

k: Where Evernoon comes apart, the Gloam comes in. It wears whatever it finds.
src: 'Where Evernoon comes apart, the Gloam comes in. It wears whatever it finds.'

k: Its strings are cut. Its sentence is unfinished. It is very, very angry about both.
src: 'Its strings are cut. Its sentence is unfinished. It is very, very angry about both.'

k: Every sentence Evernoon never finished, knotted together into something that wants, very badly, to be heard.
src: 'Every sentence Evernoon never finished, knotted together into something that wants, very badly, to be heard.'

k: The Warden's clock-face cracks — its hands spin all the way back!
src: 'The Warden\'s clock-face cracks — its hands spin all the way back!'

k: Time thickens like honey around you.
"NOON." Every bell in Evernoon rings at once.
src: '"NOON." Every bell in Evernoon rings at once.'

k: Mercy lets down her hood. "You will not take her. You will not take ANY of them." She sings the Vespersong.
src: 'Mercy lets down her hood. "You will not take her. You will not take ANY of them." She sings the Vespersong.'

k: A single soft bell begins to toll, counting someone down...
src: 'A single soft bell begins to toll, counting someone down...'

k: "Rest now." A lullaby — and under it, the bells of Evernoon begin to swing...
src: '"Rest now." A lullaby — and under it, the bells of Evernoon begin to swing...'

k: "—IT!" A hundred mouths finish the sentence at once.
src: '"—IT!" A hundred mouths finish the sentence at once.'

k: It begins to forget its own shape. Light pours through the gaps — light no longer heals it!
src: 'It begins to forget its own shape. Light pours through the gaps — light no longer heals it!'

k: A puppet tears loose from its body and staggers forward!
src: 'A puppet tears loose from its body and staggers forward!'

k: A splinter of starlight that fell when the sun broke. It hums a note too high to hear.
src: 'A splinter of starlight that fell when the sun broke. It hums a note too high to hear.'

k: Your father's cutlass, from the wreck of the Gull's Return. Still sharp. He oiled it every Sunday.
src: 'Your father\'s cutlass, from the wreck of the Gull\'s Return. Still sharp. He oiled it every Sunday.'

k: A brass signal lamp with Lanternfall's sigil, found lashed to your father's boat with a Keeper's knot.
src: 'A brass signal lamp with Lanternfall\'s sigil, found lashed to your father\'s boat with a Keeper\'s knot.'

k: A dented brass censer packed with bitterleaf. Mirefen healers burned it against rot.
src: 'A dented brass censer packed with bitterleaf. Mirefen healers burned it against rot.'

k: A seed that burns without being consumed. Thorns remember fire.
src: 'A seed that burns without being consumed. Thorns remember fire.'

k: A Dawnguard signet. It opens the Grand Lantern's tower.
src: 'A Dawnguard signet. It opens the Grand Lantern\'s tower.'

k: Crayon on sailcloth, from the children of Kiteholm. Mostly capital letters.
src: 'Crayon on sailcloth, from the children of Kiteholm. Mostly capital letters.'

k: A rusty kitchen knife. Tilly says it is the legendary Lucky Shiv. Tilly is very sure.
src: 'A rusty kitchen knife. Tilly says it is the legendary Lucky Shiv. Tilly is very sure.'

k: Captain Hal Merrow's log. The last page is addressed to someone.
src: 'Captain Hal Merrow\'s log. The last page is addressed to someone.'

k: It swims through the glass dunes the way an eel swims through weed. The dunes are in the sky now. It has not noticed.
src: 'It swims through the glass dunes the way an eel swims through weed. The dunes are in the sky now. It has not noticed.'

k: A memory of water seen by someone dying of thirst.
src: 'A memory of water seen by someone dying of thirst.'

k: Blindfolded and singing one note. Tamsin's acolytes sang the Dawnsong with their eyes covered, so they would hear it better.
src: 'Blindfolded and singing one note. Tamsin\'s acolytes sang the Dawnsong with their eyes covered, so they would hear it better.'

k: Its shell is fused desert glass. Hit it hard enough and it rings.
src: 'Its shell is fused desert glass. Hit it hard enough and it rings.'

k: What remains of Keeper Tamsin: a choir of blindfolded voices singing so loudly they cannot hear the world end.
src: 'What remains of Keeper Tamsin: a choir of blindfolded voices singing so loudly they cannot hear the world end.'

k: One voice of many. It sings harmony to a song no one else can hear.
src: 'One voice of many. It sings harmony to a song no one else can hear.'

k: The monks of Frosthollow kept a silent vigil. Some of them are still keeping it.
src: 'The monks of Frosthollow kept a silent vigil. Some of them are still keeping it.'

k: It hunts by the sound of chattering teeth.
src: 'It hunts by the sound of chattering teeth.'

k: The avalanche that killed Brother Halvard, gathered up and given a grudge.
src: 'The avalanche that killed Brother Halvard, gathered up and given a grudge.'

k: A slope of snow that remembers falling.
src: 'A slope of snow that remembers falling.'

k: Brother Halvard, kneeling in the snow, apologizing to a mountain. He has been at it for a year.
src: 'Brother Halvard, kneeling in the snow, apologizing to a mountain. He has been at it for a year.'

k: Mirefen's healers used leeches. The leeches have started using the healers.
src: 'Mirefen\'s healers used leeches. The leeches have started using the healers.'

k: Lives in the stilts. Bites the ankles of anyone who stands still too long.
src: 'Lives in the stilts. Bites the ankles of anyone who stands still too long.'

k: It waits under the boardwalks for the rot to finish its work.
src: 'It waits under the boardwalks for the rot to finish its work.'

k: Mother Osk, who nursed her village through the rot and could not stop when they died. She is still nursing.
src: 'Mother Osk, who nursed her village through the rot and could not stop when they died. She is still nursing.'
